lead_raw_text:
The structure of SmCdPd crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-3 (No. 143), with a unit cell containing six atoms (Sm2Cd2Pd2) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis shows Cd centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 geometric neighbors, while Pd centers have 9 neighbors and Sm centers have 15 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Cd and Pd polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Cd and Sm polyhedra.
